{{Quote|Neeshter syish freg'n Talus Station. Meesta krand't fnyor?|Talus Space Station|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
The '''Talus Station''', also called '''Talus Space Station''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. The station provided emergency repair services and cleared [[Starship/Legends|ships]] for landing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] below.<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> Ships hailing the station were greeted by a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] in his [[Mandaba/Legends|own language]].
